title: Completed constant realization interfaces
statement: For a scheme X, a commutative ring A and ideal I, let C be its adic completion and H the inverse limit on the pro-etale site of the constant sheaves A/I^(n+1). Define the actual scalar-extension realization, the category of bounded finite complexes and their bounded-above finite-free resolutions, and the actual quotient tensor diagrams. A module-realization record specifies the evaluation scalar map, exactness on finite C-modules, adic lissity, and projection-linear natural identifications with completed quotient-module sheaves. A reduction-comparison record consists of finite-free resolutions and a natural isomorphism of the full derived quotient diagrams, whose counit computes on K-flat complexes. These are precisely the existing interfaces of the parent theorem, relocated without a change of definition.
